title: 바람 말하기: -고 싶어요와 -고 싶어 해요
objective: Learners can say what they want to do by adding -고 싶어요 to a verb stem, ask others with -고 싶어요?, and switch to -고 싶어 해요 for a third person's wishes (친구가 한국에 가고 싶어 해요). They can also form the past (-고 싶었어요) and the negative (-고 싶지 않아요), and fix two common errors: '*친구가 가고 싶어요' and '*예쁘고 싶어요'. Because -고 싶다 goes with verbs, not adjectives, the correct form is 예뻐지고 싶어요.
summary: This worksheet teaches how to say what you want to do with -고 싶어요, how to ask others what they want, and how to talk about another person's wishes with -고 싶어 해요. It also covers the past tense (-고 싶었어요), the negative (-고 싶지 않아요), and what to do with adjectives.

task.title: SAY WHAT PEOPLE WANT
task.line: Put the verb in brackets into the right -고 싶다 form, or choose or correct the form as the instruction says.

forms.when: Talking about what you (the speaker) want to do. Add -고 싶어요 to the verb stem: 먹다 → 먹고 싶어요, 가다 → 가고 싶어요.
Asking the person you are talking to what they want to do. Use the same form with rising intonation.
forms.exampleMeaning: What do you want to do this weekend?

forms.when: Talking about what someone else (he, she, my friend, my mom) wants. You cannot see inside another person's mind, so Korean adds 하다.
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend wants to go to Korea.

forms.when: Talking about something you wanted to do in the past. The past tense goes on 싶다, not on the main verb.
forms.exampleMeaning: When I was little, I wanted to become a singer.

forms.when: Saying that you do not want to do something.
forms.exampleMeaning: It's raining. I don't want to go out.

watchOut: 친구가 한국에 가고 싶어요 (X) → 친구가 한국에 가고 싶어 해요 (O): When you talk about another person's wish, use -고싶어 해요, not -고싶어요.
먹었고 싶어요 (X) → 먹고 싶었어요 (O): Do not put the past tense on the main verb. Put it on 싶다: -고싶었어요.
예쁘고 싶어요 (X) → 예뻐지고 싶어요 (O): 예쁘다 is an adjective, so -고 싶다 cannot go on it directly. First make it 예뻐지다 ("to become pretty"), then add -고 싶어요.
exercises: Fill in the blank: 배고파요. 비빔밥을 ____. (먹다)
Fill in the blank to ask a friend: 방학에 어디에 ____? (가다)
Choose the right form: 제 동생은 강아지를 (키우고 싶어요 / 키우고 싶어 해요).
Fill in the blank with the past tense: 어제 그 영화를 ____. 그런데 시간이 없었어요. (보다)
Fill in the blank with the negative form: 너무 피곤해요. 오늘은 ____. (운동하다)
Correct the mistake: 저는 날씬하고 싶어요.
answers: 운동하고 싶지 않아요 (운동 안 하고 싶어요)
